title: PUM at SemEval-2020 Task 12: Aggregation of Transformer-based models’ features for offensive language recognition
reasoning: The paper describes a system for detecting offensive language in social media as part of the SemEval-2020 competition. It focuses on the classification accuracy of identifying offensive tweets and their targets using BERT and XLNet models, but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
